edition.notes: Not the full Kali Sahasranama. Twenty-seven public names as an index for household remembrance. Tantric paddhati and full thousand-name dump omitted on purpose.

description.hi: सहस्रनाम का द्वार — चयनित नाम, पूरी सूची नहीं।
description.en: A doorway to the sahasranama — selected names, not the full list.
